reviewer: final_normative_review (independent read-only normative and functional-design review; 2026-10-13; did not author rules or cases)
scope: functional design only; no reader or model efficacy inference

rationales.1.2: WRD-003 preserves approved part of speech, meaning and argument patterns; FC-1-2 rejects invented machining and FC-1-2-UI preserves the UI noun.
rationales.1.3: WRD-002 retains one contextual meaning and delegates naming to NAM-001; FC-1-3 distinguishes private copying from deployment.
rationales.1.4: WRD-003 preserves productive inflection without new meanings; FC-1-4 retains ongoing cooling and the UI exception.
rationales.1.8: NAM-001 preserves object naming and exceptions; FC-1-8 retains the exact drawing part name.
rationales.1.11: NAM-001 retains name consistency, history, comparison, quotation and distinct-action exceptions; FC-1-11 preserves one screen.
rationales.3.1: WRD-003 connects surface forms to approved verbs and arguments; FC-3-1 selects the signing verb.
rationales.3.4: VER-008 forbids missing records becoming actual absence; FC-3-4 preserves possibility and FC-REV-CANDIDATE restores permission.
rationales.3.5: SYN-009 delegates clear status/title forms to TXT-006 while retaining predicates for actions and obligations; FC-3-5 remains an instruction and FC-1-13-N a title.
rationales.3.7: SYN-009 permits compact statuses without replacing actions with labels; FC-3-7 retains quantity checking and introduces no approval.
rationales.4.1: SYN-008 retains all numerical/structural review signals and their unvalidated status; FC-4-1 preserves participants and FC-REV-COND both prerequisites.
rationales.4.2: EDIT-002 confirms only necessary unrecoverable roles/criteria and retains the wording-only exception. KO-001 preserves correspondence and recoverable omission. FC-4-2 retains the shared reader/selected drawing; FC-4-2-U leaves the reviewer unknown. Role confirmation is distinct from delegated assignment.
rationales.4.5: KO-001 preserves actor, object, recipient, tool, location, quantity and responsibility; omission still requires unique recovery. FC-4-5 and FC-4-2-U require clarification, while FC-4-5-G remains general.
rationales.5.1: PROC-001 separates independent actions and preserves simultaneity, but a mandatory sentence-length ceiling is still absent; partial remains.
rationales.5.2: PROC-001 covers sentences and steps; FC-5-2 and authored simultaneous cases retain continued button pressure.
rationales.5.3: KO-005 restricts ~한다 to reader actions in numbered procedures and separates commands, prohibitions, requests and questions. FC-5-3 and FC-REV-CANDIDATE preserve permission and source register.
rationales.5.4: Selected conditions survive boilerplate removal. FC-5-4 keeps green indication before action; simultaneous authored case preserves maintained pressure.
rationales.6.1: DESC-001 attaches applicability/unverified scope to the first result; FC-6-1 introduces the device definition before its exception.
rationales.6.2: DESC-005 removes only redundant scope/modality/framing or prerequisites already conveyed by order; information-bearing conditions, simultaneous/global constraints, safety and needed recaps remain. FC-6-2 and FC-REV-LINK preserve distinctions and noncausal addition.
rationales.6.3: SYN-008 retains structure/ambiguity review without the original mandatory sentence-length ceiling; partial remains.
rationales.6.6: DESC-004 retains a six-sentence review signal and logical splitting with permitted continuation, not the original mandatory paragraph ceiling; partial remains.
rationales.7.3: VER-008 preserves source/certainty and missing-record limits; FC-7-3-R uses only documented possible harm and FC-REV-NOSAFETY invents no preventive procedure.
rationales.8.5: SYN-008 retains measurement and meaning checks; FC-8-5, FC-8-5-B and FC-REV-COND preserve parenthetical information, location and conditions.
rationales.8.6: Literal exceptions and 30/31-token boundary remain; FC-8-6 and FC-8-6-Q preserve filenames, values, units and quoted titles.
rationales.8.7: SYN-008 does not permit arbitrary token joining; FC-8-7 restores boundaries and FC-8-7-N preserves the approved hyphenated name.
rationales.9.1: EDIT-002 distinguishes necessary role confirmation from unrequested assignment; EDIT-004 preserves restructuring; SYN-009 retains core predicates while delegating statuses. FC-9-1, FC-REV-CANDIDATE, FC-REV-NOORACLE and existing ±2 mm cases retain causality, permission and unresolved facts.
rationales.9.2: WRD-003 retains meaning/inflection/argument checks; FC-9-2 preserves roles and shared/unshared/absent criteria remain distinct.
rationales.9.4: KO-005 preserves established source/document/product register unless normalization is requested; NAM-001 retains terminology and exceptions. FC-9-4 preserves existing honorific instructions.

verification_guard_review.finding: Removing only the verification-state guard exactly reproduces prior compiler/generated hashes. Functional design remains 49/53, four partial; no model efficacy inference.
